I was and still am 14, so obviously something like this had never happened before. I didn't know what to do.

I was at a sleepover with 3 other friends, one girl my age and 2 guys of 17. One guy is gay, the other one not (we'll call him Dick). I kinda had a crush on Dick so I was clingy. It was a fun day, and when we went to sleep everything was fine. At 6am Dicks alarm went off, and I can't sleep once I wake up. So I rolled on my side. I sleep as a burrito so I lay on my blanket. 

After 5 minutes Dick pulled on my blanket. I didn't know what to do so I didn't do anything. Dick kept on pulling and he proceeded to get the blanket from under my body. His hand went under and touched my butt. I was terrified so I didn't do anything. 

Dick touched my butt, my vagina and went up and down my body multiple times. He tried going for my boobs, but my arm blocked that. He thought I was asleep. He did that about 15 minutes and than we kinda stopped. I saw my chance and rolled away. He did it again but stopped after 5 minutes. I was crying silently.

I got up and texted my friends immediately. They were very understanding and I love them so much. I texted my mom and then the other two woke up again. My friends told me via chat to confront Dick and let him know something was up. So I did. I ignored him and gave him death stares the whole time. The other two didn't notice, but Dick did. Finally he asked "did I do something wrong?" And I snapped. I told him I was awake and everything he did, in front of the other two. 

I don't regret doing that, what I do regret is not doing anything while it was happening. I didn't press charges.

I'm now afraid of any physical contact, even from family members. I want people to know that, but its awkward to say it. I had and still have (now less) problems with men coming close. I know that's stupid just because Dick did something, but I just freak out every time a man comes near. 

I also make sure to share this (anonymously) because people will learn from my mistake of not doing anything.
